existing_proofs_preserved: The entire signed reverse range, T=0 behavior, upper-triangular dot, fp32 casts, store and carry update are represented. Public Real contracts include successful execution, all active results and frame; the result is the actual suffix plus unspecified time-tail contribution, exactly characterized by RealFormula.expected_eq. Compare-right equivalence has no numerical rewrite assumptions, with nonempty typed execution witnesses.

production_stage_mapping.coverage: Complete reverse traversal and arbitrary source padding are retained, not only a local suffix fragment.
Shape/dtype selection, allocation and full feature/head grid remain uncomposed.

dtype_review: Both formal storage types are FloatDType while the wrapper accepts an optional torch.dtype without a floating-only guard. A precise admission boundary or nonfloating conversion routes remain absent.
branch_review: Negative start/stop and empty reverse range are explicitly represented. Partial final chunks retain unspecified values; a conventional zero-tail suffix requires an additional source-valid premise and is not silently asserted. The available flat IO statement uses a zero oracle, while region execution preserves the stronger actual-padding description.

structural_gaps.finding: The wrapper launches (ceil(S/32), B*H) after dtype selection and allocation; public Implements quantifies one launch state.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: A whole-wrapper contract must compose these programs and state the actual padded-suffix result for the returned tensor, preserving all current per-program results.

structural_gaps.finding: TypedSource quantifies FloatDType only, whereas the original dtype override has no matching source restriction.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: Missing storage/cast routes or admission cases cannot be replaced by numerical suffix assumptions.

numerical_items_eligible_for_explicit_de: Native dot, carry/reduction order and represented floating casts may be explicitly deferred. Unspecified tail behavior is retained source semantics, not a rounding item; zero-tail behavior must not be presumed.
precondition_assessment: The existing bounds, nonoverlap, positive tile size and valid-address premises are legitimate selected-domain assumptions. No unrestricted invalid-input behavior or hypothetical hardware defect is demanded. Missing wrapper composition and dtype admission are separate structural questions.
